qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcv2.text: qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcv2 has been fighting since 2015 and still sits at the very top: matchup rating at the very top and resistance to match. The accuracy is below the middle, and the lifetime board paints a middle-of-the-pack picture, with the lifetime IvI sitting far below what the matchups support. A player whose matchups tell a much taller story than the lifetime numbers.

quokkacafe.text: QuokkaCafe overwhelms with volume: bravery at the very peak, accuracy among the very best tracked, and output that never lets up. The rating, the tempo, and the staying power all stand near the top, and the lifetime IvI lands in the top ranks. The matchup kill-death mark sits above average, short of the summit — the one line trailing a ferocious card.

queen007.text: queen007 has ruled the field since 2013: the four pillars — rating, tempo, bravery, resistance — all stand near the very top, and the duel kill-death tally says the same. Accuracy and headshots both sit well above average, and the lifetime IvI trails a step behind the matchups. Consistency sits below average, the one soft spot on a card that otherwise reads like royalty.

qqqqqueen.text: QQQQQUEEN plays at full tilt and never lets the tempo drop: activity near the top, bravery right beside it, and a kill pace among the quickest tracked. Headshots land at a top rate, and the lifetime board rates the whole picture just as highly. A relentless, high-volume regular whose game holds together across the full card.

qobad.text: Qobad plays a sharp, selective game: the one-on-one kill-death tally sits near the very summit, with rating, tempo, bravery, and resistance all well above average. Both aim and headshot share rest mid-pack, and the lifetime board does too. The wrinkle is consistency, which collapses near the bottom against the strongest third — the edge vanishes when the opposition gets toughest. A card with a brilliant peak and one deep valley.

qingfengtr.text: QingFengTR keeps a tidy, well-rounded game: activity, bravery, resistance, and the matchup rating all land past the middle, with the kill-death outcome in even duels to match. The lifetime kill-death line sits mid-pack, a notch below the matchups, and the lifetime IvI line ends up in the same middle ground. Consistency holds mid-pack too — a solid, unspectacular card with no real weak spot.

qubuz.text: Qubuz has been at this since 2014, and the card reads even-keeled: the matchup rating, activity, bravery, resistance — each sits past the middle, with the kill-death showing in matched fights to match. The lifetime figures sit mid-pack across the board — kill-death, aim, headshots, and IvI alike. Consistency holds mid-pack too: a steady veteran with no headline and no soft spot.

quontexonlinux.text: QuontexOnLinux keeps every column honest: a notch above the middle in the matchups, lively through each exchange, and composed against sterner opposition. The direct-duel tally lands mid-pack, the one quiet corner of an otherwise strong card. The career numbers tell the same story as the duels, which keeps things simple: a solid regular, steady across the board.

quante.text: Quante has been at it since 2012, and the game still moves, well clear of the middle overall. Quick on the tempo, and unbothered as the opposition stiffens. The lifetime kill-death count runs near the very top, yet the lifetime IvI line sits below average — the board flatters, the matchups keep it honest. Headshots are rare, the aim middling, and the record holds steady. A long-time regular whose best numbers come with a footnote.

qzdnm.text: QZDNM plays a fast, polished game, in the upper reaches on nearly every count. Quick to set the tempo, and holding firm as the opposition stiffens. The aim is sharp, headshots land well above average, and the career board tells the same story. The results slip a little when the opposition is at its hardest, while the head-to-head account reads middling. A strong regular with one soft corner and plenty of shine.

qugemingzh.text: qugemingzh plays a fast, headshot-rich game, clearing the middle overall with a quick tempo and headshots above the middle. The matchup record sits in the middle, while the lifetime figures run a little hotter. Against the hardest opposition the spark dims — the one wrinkle in an otherwise lively game.
